sloka: सा दृष्ट्वा कर्म रामस्य कृतम् अन्यैः सुदुष्करम् ।जगाम परम उद्विग्ना लंकाम् रावण पालिताम् ॥३-३२-३॥
transliteration: sā dṛṣṭvā karma rāmasya kṛtam anyaiḥ suduṣkaram ।jagāma parama udvignā laṁkām rāvaṇa pālitām ॥3-32-3॥

translations.english: Seeing the performance of Rama which is very difficult for others, Surpanakha got scared and went to Lanka, ruled by Ravana.
